{"subject":"Congrats on Pulley's Series B","body":"Hi Andreas,

Congratulations on Pulley's $41M Series B four days ago. With the round closed, the board will likely expect a forecast, and you're hiring an Enterprise SDR Manager and two Enterprise Account Executives.

Quillpath is an AI pipeline-review assistant. It reads your CRM every night, flags stalled deals, gives each rep a short list of next actions, and writes a weekly pipeline and forecast summary you can forward to the board. Setup takes about 15 minutes on top of your existing CRM, with nothing to migrate.

Would you like to try the free 14-day pilot on your team's pipeline?","missing":["Which CRM Pulley uses (HubSpot or Salesforce)","Whether Pulley's pipeline is eligible for the pilot","Whether Pulley has a RevOps person or who currently owns the board forecast"]}
